notes.title: Throes of the Watchmaker is Coming May 20th + New Trailer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The day is set: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457510/Sea_of_Stars_Throes_of_the_Watchmaker/]Throes of the Watchmaker[/url] — the free DLC for Sea of Stars — is coming to all platforms on May 20th, 2025!

The announcement was made this morning, accompanied by a whole new trailer showcasing the scope, narrative, and tone of this wacky post-game bonus adventure. We hope you're as excited as we are, because the playtest results are in and it clocks over 8 hours of completely new content!

The scope of this DLC went way beyond what we initially envisioned, which was only made possible through the warm and overwhelming response we have been blessed with.

[previewyoutube=tgFi2jXwzVI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to help  in bringing more eyeballs to this circus-themed romp, the best way is always to leave a comment on the video on YouTube, and share our posts on social media.

[h2]THROES OF THE WATCHMAKER DEV STREAM, TODAY AT 2PM ET![/h2]

The trailer is here, and the release date is set — it’s time to celebrate! Join us live later today as we showcase Throes of the Watchmaker. We’ll take you inside the miniature clockwork world of Horloge to explore the DLC’s unique mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/0040b6dc6206026984c0f70992e584bb38b45cc4.png[/img]

Come on and join us at 2PM ET, it should be a lot of fun: twitch.tv/sabotagestudio


[h2]MALEVOLENT SPECTACLE AWAITS[/h2]

Since it’s been a long time since our latest update on the DLC, here’s a recap of what you can expect from Throes of the Watchmaker.

[h3]Over 8 hours of completely new Areas, Music, Dungeons, Mini-Games, Enemies, Bosses, and Puzzles[/h3]

Journey into a magical miniature clockwork world where a plethora of oddities and wonders await. The world of Horloge is filled with unique environments, NPCs, enemies and dungeons. This thing is packed, with Throes of the Watchmaker boasting the same budget for cinematics that the main game had, allowing us to richly realize key narrative moments and deliver this new tale with even more density and production value.

And of course, Sabotage’s composer Eric W. Brown returns alongside guest composer Yasunori Mitsuda to bring a completely fresh set of tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/789357db5511c76d2b8f7eab906d9605401e230b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/af9d786f53751119d84ddd6fc1262c8cbae03352.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f37617e2024b9fbbcbd0fb1e877415f510f49605.png[/img]

[h3]New Playable Classes for Valere and Zale[/h3]

The world of Horloge plays by different rules, and for their magic to manifest, the Solstice Warriors will need to adapt. Zale will tap into his agility to become a Juggler, while Valere will harness her balance to dazzle as an Acrobat. Playing to the circus-themed curse, they will unlock a completely new set of attacks, damage types, skills and combos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/ae04cc1afe3aa5a9b08a8607981e3b15ce6cbdcc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a70d882fc064c81ff370c31659a60320c2b2ab76.png[/img]

[h3]New Playable Character: Arty[/h3]

Artificer joins the party! The friendly engineer robot will finally unlock the laser-shooting capabilities of his construct, and join Valere and Zale in the fight to save Horloge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/eea80f22ab179a0d2d84b5705393c0152f573db9.png[/img]

[h3]Couch Co-Op With Up To 3 Players[/h3]

The couch co-op mode that was added to Sea of Stars via the Dawn of Equinox update in November 2024 is also available for Throes of the Watchmaker. It allows up to three players to engage in traversal and combat with a “Co-Op timed hits” mechanic!

[h2]THAT’S IT FOR NOW[/h2]

We’d love for you to join us for the Throes of the Watchmaker DLC dev stream later today! If you can’t make it, no worries — the VOD will be available tomorrow, and we’ll see you on May 20th when the DLC launches for free, everywhere.

We hope that this farewell letter to our dream project will bring you joy, and that you will allow it to tell you one last time, from all of us: THANK YOU!

All the love,
-SaboTeam

notes.title: The Dawn of Equinox Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]The Dawn of Equinox update is available to download for free on all platforms, right now![/b]

Here’s the new trailer, showcasing some of the main changes coming with the update:

[previewyoutube=pk6FYIift0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We ultimately see Dawn of Equinox as the community’s gift to us - the overwhelming support you’ve all shown us ever since we first announced Sea of Stars helped give our team the chance to return to the project, and present a refined version of it including everything we ever hoped this adventure to be.

There's even more in store in the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, but in the meantime, we couldn’t be happier with how Sea of Stars feels with this major update.

[h2]DAWN OF EQUINOX UPDATE OVERVIEW[/h2]

In case you missed it, the key changes were presented comprehensively during [url=https://youtu.be/mDDSCbmXmBk]a livestream[/url] a few weeks ago.

[h3]3 Player Couch Co-op[/h3]

Sea of Stars’ adventure is now playable in its entirety by up to three players, with allies traversing the world together and mastering a new Co-op Timed Hits combat mechanic. Yes, what was initially presented as a more limited “Single Player +” mode has evolved into a full-fledged co-op experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4a320147836eac1c83a1c22f85b5ef7ac1cd8485.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f0f63a72d8c74a6d5fcc6272e1366477523d2a43.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/7a836d6af59acc2d08d7c5edab06a93063a4e8d7.png[/img]

[h3]Combat 2.0[/h3]

The addition of Mystery Locks brings a new gameplay loop around revealing the ways to break the spells of new enemies entering the fray. Along with "Reveal" functions added to some of the special skills, Combo Points now remain after battle, offering new ways to open certain encounters, or test different damage types on enemies to reveal their locks. 

A comprehensive balancing pass has also been done to reflect both these new changes and player feedback since launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6234c5decad3c300d7105e087b2267bc8fc504b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/127a0baaa284716c11bbe25c34605cb884bec91a.png[/img]

[h3]A revamped prologue[/h3]

Implementing combat for the young versions of our heroes, the updated flow does away with the flashback structure to begin in their childhood directly including action in the prologue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c8caf743e97cb06e7b3efded71d75581bbac1b2d.png[/img]

[h3]Bonus Cinematic Scene[/h3]

An entirely new cutscene has been added to accentuate a pivotal moment in the original adventure, referred to as "Paths on Water".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c91cbd8a2e266dfcc0fddce488188f073196d18e.png[/img]

[h3]Speedrunner Mode Relic[/h3]

This new Relic was designed with the help of the speedrunning community, activating a range of features helpful for those looking to set a new personal best or world record.

[h3]Difficulty Presets[/h3]

Three difficulty settings are now available when starting a new game, which are presets using the game's Relics. New Relics have also been added, some for quality of life, and others for difficulty adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a3336be64774dcce23dd2601de363027ac172b06.png[/img]

[h3]Improved Parrot Relic[/h3]

The secret-tracking parrot has learned a few new tricks to better assist players tracking down overlooked challenges and collectibles.

[h3]Québécois Localization[/h3]

The long-awaited, comprehensive French Canadian translation for our Québec folks is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6b2f88a138eccb32dc7a3164d5c934ffeb139a70.png[/img]

A number of other general updates, bug fixes and QoL improvements spanning Sea of Stars’ full campaign are also part of the Dawn of Equinox update.

[h2]THAT’S IT FOR NOW[/h2]

We’re grateful for all the love and support the game has received over the past year, which made it possible for us to fully realize our vision. We hope this will give fans of the game plenty of reasons to revisit it while waiting for the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, coming Spring 2025.

All the love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: Dawn of Equinox Update is Coming for Free on November 12!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In parallel with the DLC we've been working on the next major update for Sea of Stars titled Dawn of Equinox, which is officially set to arrive on all platforms on November 12!

[b]Dawn of Equinox[/b] will bring to life the completed vision for Sea of Stars, incorporating everything that couldn’t be included at launch, along with some of the most requested features and improvements informed by feedback from players.

[b]Join us on a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/sabotagestudio]Twitch livestream[/url] Tuesday October 1st at 2PM ET for an in-depth look at the plethora of changes coming to the game.[/b] For now, here’s an overview of what this free update has to offer.

[h1]DAWN OF EQUINOX UPDATE OVERVIEW[/h1]

[h3]3 Player Local Co-op[/h3]

Sea of Stars’ story will be playable in its entirety by up to three players, with allies traversing the world together and mastering a new Co-op Timed Hits combat mechanic. What was initially presented as a very limited “Single Player +” mode has evolved into a full-fledged Co-op experience. 

Don’t miss tomorrow’s stream for a comprehensive breakdown of this all-new mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/3c37a0f3504b41461f56f0a8ddbd890994b5870e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f0f63a72d8c74a6d5fcc6272e1366477523d2a43.png[/img]

[h3]Combat 2.0[/h3]

The addition of Mystery Locks brings a new gameplay loop around revealing the ways to break the spells of new enemies entering the fray. Along with "Reveal" functions added to some of the special skills, Combo Points now remain after battle, offering new ways to open certain encounters, or test different damage types on enemies to reveal their locks. 

A comprehensive balancing pass has also been done to reflect both these new changes and player feedback since launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/0eb1ca6ca9cf1ad71fcfea1b46674757536b0f4f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/127a0baaa284716c11bbe25c34605cb884bec91a.png[/img]

[h3]A revamped prologue[/h3]

Implementing combat for the young versions of our heroes, the updated flow does away with the flashback structure to begin in their childhood directly including action in the prologue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c8caf743e97cb06e7b3efded71d75581bbac1b2d.png[/img]

[h3]Bonus Cinematic Scene[/h3]

An entirely new cutscene has been added to accentuate a pivotal moment in the original adventure, referred to as "Paths on Water".

[h3]A Speedrunner Mode Relic[/h3]

This new item activates a range of features helpful for those looking to set a new personal best or world record.

[h3]Difficulty Presets[/h3]

Three difficulty options are now available when starting a new game, which are presets using the game's Relics. New Relics have also been added, both for quality of life and difficulty adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a3336be64774dcce23dd2601de363027ac172b06.png[/img]

[h3]Improved Parrot Relic[/h3]

Sea of Stars’ secret-tracking parrot has learned a few new tricks to better assist players tracking down overlooked challenges and collectibles.

[h3]Québécois Localization[/h3]

A comprehensive French Canadian translation for our Quebec folks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/d15370bf249dcd9c9b803e76f6382e46ad5e0eef.png[/img]

A number of other general updates, bug fixes and QoL improvements spanning Sea of Stars’ full campaign will also be part of the Dawn of Equinox update. Again, make sure to join us on Twitch, on October 1st at 2PM ET for a deep-dive on all these changes!

[h1]THAT’S IT FOR NOW[/h1]

We’re grateful for all the love and support the game has received over the past year, which has made it possible for us to fully realize our vision. We hope this will give fans of the game plenty of reasons to revisit it while waiting for Throes of the Watchmaker in Spring  2025.

We’ll be back with more info when the update is ready to go live!

All the love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: Sea of Stars DLC is Coming for Free Spring 2025!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re almost exactly one year away from the release of Sea of Stars (!!!), and while we've been a bit quiet lately, we’re excited to share some fantastic news today.

[b]Throes of the Watchmaker is coming Spring 2025, for free![/b]

[previewyoutube=yBnJv-rQjMM;full][/previewyoutube]

Visit the [url=https://seaofstarsgame.co/throes-of-the-watchmaker-dlc/]DLC’s website[/url] for everything there is to know so far. We hope you’re as excited as we are about this new adventure!

[h1]Malevolent Spectacle Awaits[/h1]

Throes of the Watchmaker finds the Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale venturing into the miniature clockwork world of Horloge. In this magical land where denizens are threatened by a cursed carnival, our heroes will need to adapt to unfamiliar rules if their Sun and Moon powers are to manifest.

[h2]New playable classes for Valere and Zale[/h2]

To fight against the minions of The Puppeteer, Zale will tap into his agility to become a Juggler, while Valere will harness her balance to dazzle as an Acrobat. Playing to the circus-themed curse, they will unlock a completely new set of equipment, attacks, damage types, skills and combos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/bf9d313b53a1354ff6874045571386080857604c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/9dd80521cfe3b9bb18a6fae585816be4da718c63.png[/img]

[h2]New playable character: Arty![/h2]

Artificer joins the party! The friendly engineer robot will finally unlock the laser-shooting capabilities of his construct, and join Valere and Zale in the fight to save Horloge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/bee6333d42eb9feaf042012dcb4ca035e05fd8e0.png[/img]

[h2]Completely new areas, music, dungeons, enemies, bosses and puzzles[/h2]

Journey into a magical miniature clockwork world where a plethora of oddities and wonders await. The world of Horloge, where a cursed carnival threatens the innocent denizens, is filled with unique environments, NPCs, enemies and dungeons. And of course, Sabotage’s composer Eric W. Brown and special collaborator Yasunori Mitsuda return to bring a completely fresh set of tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/660f3cfe244e4832451835d07c44061f116b4566.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/5cc323c049a1b813061ac3e1c50783e858d88701.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/bbcbb7f58e473305fb4080b5afa27ac5962b7779.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4460bbf1d559775abd7bf3407f59d7df8f0e5ff7.png[/img]

[h2]Local Co-op with up to 3 players[/h2]

Throes of the Watchmaker will follow Sea of Stars’ local co-op update, which will allow three players to journey through Sea of Stars’ main adventure together. When it comes out, the entirety of the DLC will also be playable in three person co-op.

One year later, we're still overwhelmed by the continued love and enthusiasm for this world we created, and we can't wait for you to spend a few more hours discovering these new areas.

We’ll be back soon with updates for the rest of 2024.

[b]-SaboTeam[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.46981 (heavy spoilers)
notes.content:
- Added a new Relic: Tactician’s Mettle, which will unlock after the graduation ceremony. It is also given retroactively when loading a save beyond that point in Zenith Academy.
- Updated all campfire rest scenes to offer more varied placement and animations.
- Sea of Nightmare: Fixed an issue that could cause the break crystal cutscene to not play entirely, locking the player in Sea of Nightmare. Save files that are locked in Sea of Nightmare should be fixed after a reload.
- Adjusted the logic on the Parrot to properly offer insight regarding Fishing Island’s conches.
- Fixed props flickering, clipping and adjusted collisions in multiple levels.
- Fixed known typos in all languages.
- Fixed crash that could occur when spamming the “back” button while the end game save screen appeared.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the player’s death count to be incorrect.
- Fixed issue where dying after an auto-save could also overwrite the manual save.
- Adjusted Bs't’s animations in some cutscenes where the combat pose could be playing when not intended.
- Adjusted animations on some characters to prevent idle breaker animations from playing during Stormcaller and Acolytes fights outro cutscenes.
- Adjusted party advice to avoid lines about going to Settler Island while already on the island.
- Made sure that Clockwork Castle’s name is displayed properly in the hud when loading the scene from Mirth.
- Conflagrate should no longer emit scorch marks after the fire pillar has disappeared.
- Fishing: removed water VFX that could appear when bobber lands on land.
- Adjusted some enemies in Dweller's Fall Arena to make sure they don't give XP.
- Fixed an issue that caused Three's idle animation to interrupt the "low health idle" animation.
- Added checks to ensure that the level up music plays properly in Maelstrom Point and Trek to Center of the World.
- Added checks to ensure the player icon can be seen on the map screen even when the player is near the borders.
- Added checks to ensure consistent letterboxing during the "Sea of Stars Sequence" camera shift.
- Fixed a glitch in the Game Menu's character portrait tray when switching between gamepad and keyboard.
- Changing the PixelPerfect video option during Fishing minigame will now update the letterboxing.
- Fixed character misplacement that could occur when spamming pause while using the clock tower's big lift.
- Added Sequent Flare timing VFX and SFX to Arcane Barrage combo move.
- MossyCache: Added a check to prevent a character potentially getting stuck in running animation.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the game to change resolution for a few moments during loading screens.
- Fixed an issue that caused the character sprites in the loading screen to flicker and run too fast.
- Added checks to make sure all "boat triggers" that remove map fog can also be triggered while flying.
- Cooking: added a check to prevent the quantity selector SFX to play while grayed out.
- Fixed an issue that could cause Resh'an's puppet to unintentionally have dialogue.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the player to do negative damage in some cases.
- Fixed an issue that caused the pirate music track 36 to not play properly.
- Fixed an issue that caused Gaëtan Piment's hand to flip after talking to him a few times.
- Stonemasons Outpost: Made sure that the right cutscene is played for the water pump and statue.
- Wraith Island Docks: Made sure that the raft is still visible after loading a save file.
- Fixed an issue that could cause undiscovered area names to not display properly if the language is changed while they are displayed.
- Brisk Arena: Fixed an issue that could cause the camera to follow B’st after exiting the arena.
- Cerulean Expense: Disabled probe during level up sequence.
- Fixed an issue that caused no attack name to be displayed while Romaya summons Lonzon or Revenant
- Cursed Woods: Fixed an issue that could prevent the player from accessing menus after playing the cutscene for opening the passage.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the camera to be locked after yeeting to X’tol or Y'eet.
- Antsudlo: Fixed an issue with climbing and changing water level.
- Antsudlo: Adjusted follower behavior to prevent them from getting stuck mid air.
- Added an auto full heal to the party before the Dweller of Woe encounter.
- Fixed possible softlock when using a combat move after the Dweller of Strife encounter.
- Added a full heal after each Boss fight in the arena.
- Fixed an inconsistency in diagonal flight speed that occurred depending on whether D-pad or joystick was being used.
- Now disabling all in-game hud panels during encounter outros.
- Fixed the locked TOD (time of day) when loading a save file on the second planet after defeating Dweller of Dread.
- Fixed an issue with focus crystal activation zones when swapping the party leader.
- Adjusted a chest that could be found floating in the air in the Cursed Woods.
- Fixed an issue with the light ball trigger position after a failed landing.
- Added a check to cancel avoidance when a character gets selected, to prevent them from potentially getting stuck in the avoid state and softlock the encounter.
- Antsudlo: Added a failsafe to make sure the water's level is correct after reloading the save.
- Vespertine: added a check to muffle the pirate music in Resh'an's room.
- Added a check to resurrect KO'd party members in-between Catalyst phases.
- Sea of Nightmare: Fixed an issue that caused interaction with a stone totem to show outdated information after shattering the crystals.
- Fixed an issue that caused Shimmering Shard to not actually increase damage against undead.
- Fixed crash that could occur after 5 or more strife minion eyeballs exploded in a single move.
- Wizard Lab: Fixed an issue where the user could miss out on a chest if they did the purple room first and didn't use the pearl stand. Fix has been implemented retroactively, so anyone missing a chest should now find it in the magenta room.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the title to become unresponsive if the player changes party order at the very start of combat.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when trying to change the equipped weapon of a character while having a certain quantity of duplicates.
- Fixed a possible crash when sending the leader to the back row while a "loot notification queue" is running.
- Fixed an issue that could cause a crash if the player receives a loot notification after the Golden Pelican sequence.
- Increased compatibility to help the PC version of the game run on some older cpus.
- Fixed a specific encounter's intro which could result in a crash if the player initiated combat with a sneak attack.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when a follower gets deactivated or stops following the leader while a geyser is waiting for them.
- Fixed an issue that could cause some SFX to persist throughout the credits if both the player and World Eater die on the same frame.
- Fixed B.S. Roulette to prevent the "back" button from being used during the dialog choice.
- Dweller's Fall Arena: Fixed an issue that could cause loss of HP/MP when entering/exiting.
- Fixed a crash/softlock that could happen while B'st was the first follower and entered a climb zone from the top.
- Fixed a softlock/crash that could occur if the Dweller of Strife died on the same hit as the crystal device got fully charged.
- Fixed an issue where the tight ropes could disappear when the player landed on them.
- Fixed an issue where a crash could occur when teleporting or talking to an NPC at a specific time during their pathfinding.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash if the Graplou was used immediately after combat.
- Fixed an issue that could cause Duke Aventry's sprite to vanish from the cutscene if the party leveled up by beating him.

notes.content:

- Adjusted collisions in one of the Molekin houses

- Fixed an issue where the paincone projectile could get pooled before reaching its target when running the game at very high fps
- Updated combat management to prevent targets that have left the encounter from checking against damage zones (i.e. fixing a softlock when defeating Romaya with conflagrate while she's on the bone pillar, who will now instead be properly immune to damage in this situation)

notes.title: Sea of Stars is verified on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

There are only two weeks left until launch, and [b]we are happy to confirm that Sea of Stars has officially passed certification, and is verified on Steam Deck![/b]

This means everything is locked in and out of hands now--like everyone else, we're just waiting for it to go live on August 29th, which is proving to be one of the most challenging steps of this whole journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f1a5a17d2c9dd49f8bc2c0cf41c0baed992ea8ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/82082241daea87462cef01b131d9568848221647.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/5a9ff63614fb9ebbbd3dd61b125c219ab05362ec.png[/img]

[h1]THE 'MAKING OF' DOCUMENTARY FROM THE ESCAPIST IS NOW AVAILABLE[/h1]

Back in April, The Escapist’s documentary team flew to Québec City to visit our studio for a few days. We had a great time sharing our story and opening up about our process a little more. As of today, you can watch the full thing (runtime 35 minutes) on their [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NvsDBAcKFDw]YouTube channel[/url].

In case you are worried about spoilers, since the documentary was a Kickstarter stretch goal meant to release before launch we made sure not to show or discuss anything outside of what has been shown already in trailers and social media posts. So, if you have been avoiding everything so far it's probably best to save this one for later, but if you have been keeping up, rest assured that you won't find any spoilers in there!

[previewyoutube=NvsDBAcKFDw;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to thank everyone at The Escapist for the amazing opportunity. Working with them has been a real treat, and we will remain forever grateful at how they managed to capture such an important moment of our lives.  One for the old days!

If you feel like spreading the word, the best way is to like the video, leave a comment on YouTube, and share [url=https://twitter.com/seaofstarsgame/status/1691475356140609536]this tweet[/url].

Enjoy!

[h1]THAT’S IT FOR NOW![/h1]

Only two weeks left until you all get to explore the little world we built. As the press is busy playing the build and writing their reviews (embargo lifts August 28th, a day before launch), we join the wait while being thankful that it is now only a short one.

Thank you all once again for your overwhelming support.

-SaboTeam

tags.feature: we are happy to confirm that Sea of Stars has officially passed certification, and is verified on Steam Deck!

You can download it now for your PC or Steam Deck by going to our store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4c782d2d7c91659ed88a23925c631914f69b4eb0.png[/img]

While the demo features areas that will be part of the final game, we made sure to pick a slice that did not reveal any major spoilers from the main story. It is designed to give a hint of context, but mostly showcase some gameplay systems and mechanics around dungeon crawling and combat. It aims to provide a sense of the tone and vibe without giving away major points of the journey.

For those who might be wondering, it is the exact same demo that was released on Nintendo Switch back in February, including the minor updates that followed.

The demo will remain available on Steam after the Steam Next Fest.

[h1]PLEASE SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK ABOUT THE DEMO![/h1]

We’ll increase our presence on [url=https://discord.gg/sabotagestudio]our Discord[/url] over the following days to gather feedback and answer questions. Feel free to come talk to us and share your thoughts in the #sos-demo-feedback channel! 

Also,  while we did a pass for compatibility testing, it’s virtually impossible to cover every and all possible hardware configurations. Should you encounter any technical issues and want to help us make adjustments for your configuration type before launch, you can provide any details you find relevant along with the following information:

- Windows version
- Graphics card
- Graphics driver version
- Motherboard
- CPU model
- Monitor resolution
- Monitor refresh rate
- Input device

[h1]WHEELS MINIGAME REVEAL![/h1]

We finally revealed Wheels, the famous game known by all in the world of Sea of Stars. Wheels is an optional tabletop game that you’ll be able to play whenever you want to take a break from adventuring. 

If you want to know more right now, here’s Thierry showing the minigame while the pirate band plays music:

[previewyoutube=0q7WsoeQHMA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Production Update + Spring Q&A Stream
notes.content:
[h1]Q&A + WIZARD LAB DUNGEON PREVIEW ON TWITCH THIS FRIDAY MAY 13TH, AT 2PM EST / 11AM PST / 8PM CET[/h1]

[previewyoutube=XilwGr_HAiM;full][/previewyoutube]

Back in February, around 20 minutes of new content from Sea of Stars was shown to a selected few media outlets. This preview included an updated look on many systems and a quest involving pirates, the port town of Brisk and mysterious arcane ruins known as the “Abandoned Wizard’s Lab”. 

Polish has gone a long way since our last stream, so we wanted to share this segment of Sea of Stars with our community. [b]Make sure to tune in on Twitch this Friday May 13th, at 2PM EST / 11AM PST / 8PM CET![/b] 

https://www.twitch.tv/sabotagestudio

The second half of the stream is reserved for Q&A. Join us if you are curious about the behind the scenes, or have a question of your own! We opened a #qna channel [url=https://discord.gg/sabotagestudio]on Discord[/url] to drop your questions ahead of time.

Rest assured that this preview won’t reveal critical story beats or spoil anything other than lower-stakes events from the game. 

[h1]QUICK DEV UPDATE[/h1]

In other news, here are a few spoiler-free dev updates you might have missed on social media. Most of these are low risk items we were saving for later in production. It's pretty exciting to be at a point where we are tackling these kinds of things! 

First, we’ve been asked many times over the last 2 years whether the full battle party would be seen running around outside of combat.

Yes, of course!

[previewyoutube=zKJ5mAwTCP0;full][/previewyoutube]

And here’s an updated look at sailing.

[previewyoutube=Y51Bv0017KU;full][/previewyoutube]

The combat hud also got a revamp! While not quite final, this new version offers more breathing space and readability.

[previewyoutube=oCFcLtiMEqw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]DEVELOPMENT IS GOING GREAT, BUT WE DON’T HAVE A RELEASE DATE YET
[/h1]

Production's velocity is at full throttle, with every part of the game gradually falling into place. While the road to a gold master has many more miles in store for us, it is quite thrilling to be at the front seat of Sea of Stars growing into its final form.

We're not ready to set a release date just yet, but the pace is good, and the team is committed to achieving the complete vision with no compromises. Remaining platforms and storefronts announcements will be coming soon, after which we will send the survey for the final phase of fulfillment (platform choices for physical and digital copies, civic address for shipping, name for the credits, etc.) 

Stay tuned! ​​And as always, we thank you for your patience and overwhelming support 

All the love,

- SaboTeam
